title: Great News! BlueJay and G6
body:
Good news for all who are integrating their sensors with the BlueJay U2 smartwatch.
You can download and use the BYOD G6 App on that small watch too! Just download the apk file on your watch and follow the instructions to install it. 
Make sure to download the apk version for android 6 OS. As this BlueJay U2 watch is running android 8 OS.
This is a great idea for those using the watch and still like to upload their Dexcom readings to CLARITY or Dexcom Follow.
I have attached here a few pictures showing G6 On Bluejay U2 Watch.
[Unfortunately, since the new BYOD G7 doesn't  support android 8 OS. Is this available only for those using G6]
